# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified distribution downloaded from `https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/` on 2026-09-14. All PNGs in `images/` come from that distribution. BSD-2-Clause license is included in `LICENSE`.

Official distribution and published integrity values: https://leafletjs.com/download.html

- leaflet.js SHA-256 (base64): `20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=`
- leaflet.css SHA-256 (base64): `p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=`

These files are served locally; the app does not require a JavaScript CDN at runtime. Nila uses its own letter markers and layer controls; upstream images are retained for distribution completeness. No background tiles are bundled or prefetched.
